message.content: {"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && printf '%s\\n' '# tinydb milestone 1 - HANDOFF' '' 'Implemented tinydb/journal.py with BatchWriter(db).' 'R03: ordinary API intact; deep-copy on insert so no aliasing; previously acquired table handles reflect success and rollback.' '' 'Tests: tests/test_journal.py (64 pass).
